title: Noah's excuses end: ACLU injunction, rainbow, and "The government already has"
summary: Punchline of the humorous modern-Noah story: the ACLU gets an injunction against building the Ark as an unconstitutional religious event; then the sky clears and a rainbow appears, Noah hopefully asks if God will not destroy the earth, and the Lord sadly answers that He does not have to because the government already has.

text.text: Finally, the ACLU got the courts to issue an injunction against further construction of the Ark, saying that since God is flooding the earth, it is a religious event and therefore, unconstitutional. I really don’t know if I will ever be able to finish the Ark," Noah wailed.
The sky began to clear, the sun began to shine and the seas began to calm. A rainbow arched across the sky. Noah looked up hopefully. "You mean You are not going to destroy the earth Lord?"
"No," said the Lord sadly. "I don't have to. The government already has."

keywords: not going to destroy the earth
